Its first pass over records 0..[0x866ecc] (ring_008943a0: lap end 4..26) reads movsx word +0xcc (bank: |x| clamped to 0x4000, *6 >> 14 into level 0..6) and movsx word +0xce ('cmp edx,-0x1000; jge' then, with word +0xca < 0x2800, its negation scaled the same way can raise the level and set +0x70 bit 0); the third pass XORs neighbouring +0xcc words ('jns': a sign change resets the level). These words are zero in the image and no family layout varies them, so the level was always 0 (bank, sign-flip and |level difference| > 1 branches unreached). Both draw for 32 records from 0, +-1, +-0x1000 and -0x1001 (the -0x1000 boundary), +-0x2000, +-0x4000 and +-0x4001 (the clamp), 0x7fff/0x8000 and two odd values: signed words, only compared/negated/scaled (no fault).
